data.name: Hemlatha
data.gender_notes: Hemlatha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hemlatha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘hema’ which means gold or wealth and ‘latha’ which means flow. This name is associated with the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. It is believed that the name Hemlatha brings good fortune and abundance in one's life. The name Hemlatha carries the meaning “Goddess of wealth, prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hemlatha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hemlatha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of wealth, prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hemlatha total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

It is a name that is believed to bring good fortune and abundance in one's life, both materially and spiritually. This name is often given to girls in Hindu families, especially during the festivals of Diwali and Navratri, which celebrate the abundance and divine grace of Lakshmi.

Ultimately, the name Hemlatha inspires us to live a life that is abundant in both material and spiritual riches, and to recognize the inner wealth that we all possess.
